actual_test02.binding_immutable_positive: Installed BEFORE UPDATE trigger rejects the attempted profile_ref change. After rollback the original ref/hash/technical tuple is unchanged. Because authority remains valid, exactly one callback/marker/LOG is expected and observed through the passing assertions.
actual_test02.profile_revoked_negative: The current bound Artifact is cloned, marked REVOKED, bumped and stored as a new version. runtime_bindings is left untouched. currentRuntimeBinding rejects its old frozen reference and BeforeModelTurn rejects with zero accepted callback and no marker. This is real admissibility revocation, not replacement of an immutable binding.
actual_test02.owner_negative: The foreign Host principal persists through both callback completion and a denied Get. Only after workers finish and foreign Get returns an error is the original test authority restored for history inspection. Saved callback failure, zero accepted authorization and no-marker assertions still apply; restoration cannot reopen that consumed run.
actual_test02.artifact_fault: Artifact INSERT trigger aborts the authorization LOG transaction after marker creation. The marker remains; repeated callback fails with os.ErrExist, no LOG escapes rollback, and another Scan does not start a second run.
